title.narrative: Strengthening Food Security for Internally Displaced Individuals inside collective shelters, including Fishermen and Beekeepers

description.narrative: ltpgtThe originally approved intervention aimed to support vulnerable farmers through the provision of drip irrigation systems and cash assistance in selected locations in South Lebanon. However, following the recent escalation of hostilities, the operational context has significantly deteriorated. Widespread insecurity, restricted access, large-scale displacement, and the evacuation of targeted communities have rendered the implementation of in-kind agricultural infrastructure unfeasible. Farmers are no longer able to safely access or cultivate their land, and field-based installations cannot be implemented in a manner that is safe, effective, or conflict-sensitive.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtAt the same time, the escalation has resulted in significant displacement, with large numbers of households residing in collective shelters and facing acute food insecurity due to disrupted livelihoods, limited purchasing power, and reduced access to fresh and nutritious food. Under these conditions, the original intervention no longer responds to the most urgent needs of the affected population, nor does it align with current access and security constraints.lt/pgtltpgtltbrgtIn response, and following consultations with—and at the request of—the Ministry of Agriculture (MoA), as well as approval from the Food Security and Agriculture Sector (FSAS) Coordinator, DCA proposes to repurpose the project into a dual emergency response modality:ltbrgtlt/pgtltolgtltligtEmergency unconditional cash assistance to protect and sustain the livelihoods of conflict-affected beekeepers and fishermen, whose productive assets and income sources are at high risk of irreversible loss andlt/ligtltligtSupport the establishment of kitchens spaces in shelters, to ensure displaced and conflict affected households have consistent access to safe and nutritious meals.lt/ligtltligtProvision of fresh food ingredients (vegetables) to community kitchens, reinforcing their capacity to deliver regular, balanced meals to displaced and conflict affected populations.lt/ligtltligt Distribution of daily hot meals to IDPs inside collective shelters ensuring they meet their basic food needs.lt/ligtlt/olgtltpgtltbrgtThe cash-based component enables rapid, flexible, and dignified assistance in areas with restricted access, allowing beneficiaries to protect critical livelihood assets and meet urgent needs. The kitchen space component addresses immediate food consumption gaps among displaced populations in shelter settings, while strengthening community-based coping mechanisms and collective support structures. Supplying kitchens with fresh produce further contributes to dietary diversity and nutrition, while creating potential linkages with local producers where feasible.ltbrgtlt/pgt
